FAQs: K2 Base
Fast and accurate planning of K2 mounting systems for pitched and flat roofs. We show how it's done.
What are you looking for?
General Project planning: Flat roof Cooperation Project Loads Project planning: Pitched roof 
General
What is Base and how does it work?
Can I register with K2 Base as a private individual?
Do I have to pay to use Base?
How can I register with K2 Base?
I have registered and cannot use Base yet. What is the reason for this?
I registered, but I get an error message when I try to log in. What should I do?
I've forgotten my password. What should I do?
Why can I no longer change my project data?
I get the error message 422. What is the reason for this?
I get the error message 502, what can I do?
How do I transfer my data from PVSol to Base?

I have transferred my project from PV Sol to K2 Base and cannot select any terminals. What do I do?

Can I plan a ground-mounted PV system in Base?
Can I plan a façade system in Base?
I can no longer find an older project. Has it been deleted?
I would like to download all my base projects at once. Is that possible?
Why don't I see any projects? Are my projects deleted?
Projects are missing. What should I do if I don't see all my colleagues' projects?
How do I delete a project?
I want to copy a project and use it as a template. How does it work?
Can I plan a facade system in Base?
Project planning: Flat roof
How to read the structural analysis report for flat roof systems in the K2 Base PDF Report?
How can I combine S-Dome and D-Dome systems on one roof?
How can I align the modules vertically or upright with the Dome system?
What is the yellow line? Why do I have to keep an edge distance? (Flat roof)
My flat roof has different slopes. How can I plan the slope structure in K2 Base?
When is GreenRoof Vento coming to K2 Base?
Can I reduce the edge distances or set them to 0?
Where can I plan fall protection in K2 Base?
How can I place individual modules at the end of a row, especially in the D-Dome system?
How do I determine the coefficient of static friction? Which coefficient of friction do I use?
How do I optimise ballast?
The parapet has a different height. Which height do I enter for K2 Base?
To what extent do obstacles influence the ballasting?
Why is the ballasting at K2 relatively low compared to other mounting system manufacturers?
Can the modules in Base be rotated by more than 15 degrees and if so, how?
Up to how many degrees of roof pitch is a roof considered a flat roof in the base?
Are elevation systems also displayed for flat roofs or up to what inclination are they displayed?
Why are some ballast values highlighted in red in K2 Base?
Cooperation
Where do I see my colleagues' projects?
How can I edit or delete my colleagues' projects?
How do I share my projects with people outside my company?
How can I download my project file (k2o) and send it to K2, for example?
Project
The map view in the "Roof" section is different than in the "Project" section. Why is that?
My house does not appear on Google Maps, it is in a new development area. What can I do?
How can I upload my own images to Base, such as drone photos or PDFs, to use them instead of Google Maps to create templates?
Loads
How can I enter the values for the loads manually or change them manually?
Project planning: Pitched roof
Is it possible to specify a generalised cantilever arm length in Base?
How do I plan a dome system with elevation on trapezoidal sheet metal?
What do I do with a cantilever and a rail that is overloaded on one side?
How large can the cantilever arm be?
How do I plan sheet metal tiles or metal roof tiles in K2 Base?
Does the use of sheet metal tiles affect the K2 Base layout?

How do I take the counter battens into account when planning?
How do I plan the horizontal and vertical installation on a roof surface?

Can a cross bond or 2-layer rails be planned in Base?

Testing Sunny Design Pro
You can try out Sunny Design Pro free of charge for 30 days. You will receive a message when you log on in Sunny Design before the Sunny Design Pro test phase expires.
Access to Sunny Design Pro will be blocked once the test phase expires. You will then no longer have access to the energy system projects. These projects will not be deleted and can be edited again as soon as you are signed back up to Sunny Design Pro.
Procedure:
On your personal home page in the area SUNNY DESIGN PRO, select the option Test it now.
A window with information on how to proceed further will open.
Follow the on-screen instructions.
The test access to Sunny Design Pro will be enabled for 30 days.

# Testing Sunny Design Pro

* * *

You can try out Sunny Design Pro free of charge for 30 days. You will receive a message when you log on in Sunny Design before the Sunny Design Pro test phase expires.

Access to Sunny Design Pro will be blocked once the test phase expires. You will then no longer have access to the energy system projects. These projects will not be deleted and can be edited again as soon as you are signed back up to Sunny Design Pro.

**Procedure:**

1.  On your personal home page in the area **SUNNY DESIGN PRO**, select the option **Test it now**.
2.  A window with information on how to proceed further will open.
3.  Follow the on-screen instructions.

*   The test access to Sunny Design Pro will be enabled for 30 days.
